_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Course Configuration Documentation Plan
summary: Provides an outline showing how a course will be configured, containing the format and content preparation instructions for the course configuration documentation data product.
use_relationship:
The Course Configuration Documentation Plan will provide an outline to show how the course will be configured.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of this document cited herein, including its approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Course Configuration Documentation Plan shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall contain the following:

children.title: File placement
children.content: File naming convention shall not be overly complex. (e.g., clear module folder names and file structure should be easily recognizable.) Files used more than once should reside in the main directory of the course (e.g., Image.gif used in all modules should reside in the image folder within the main directory of the course and not in a module directory.

children.title: Course folder shall be broken down
children.content: Course folder shall be broken down by module so the government will be able to tell that a particular course file belongs to Module X and is on page Y of that module.

children.title: Module folders
children.content: Module folders shall contain supporting subfolders (example: flash, source, and image).
